837:t_1:5.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「This is the $$枢密参謀院$$ of our world.」

837:t_1:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The supreme authority of the Earth Empire... So that got transferred too...」

837:t_1:7.en:
$$長老$$
「Though in this world, we're nothing but spectators with no power at all.」

837:t_1:8.en:
$$長老$$
「Still, a long life has its rewards. I might get to see with my own eyes the rite of passage by which humanity becomes truly adult.」

837:t_1:9.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「As ordered, I've brought $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

837:t_1:10.en:
$$長老$$
「Well done, Colonel $$ハトリ$$. Thank you for turning down the evacuation to $$蒼の地球$$ and lending us your strength.」

837:t_1:11.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Not at all... As a member of the $$宇宙軍$$, I had already decided to assist the Galactic Raid Fleet.」

837:t_1:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So, what's the point of bringing me here? I heard there was a key to saving humanity, so I split off from $c...」

837:t_1:15.en:
$$長老$$
「We took the liberty of looking into you, and into that $$バスターマシン７号$$... the android called $$ノノ$$.」

837:t_1:16.en:
$$長老$$
「You feel a distance from that android. That's a reaction to the transcendent power she holds...」

837:t_1:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Who cares about Number 7, right? She's her own person.」

837:t_1:18.en:
$$長老$$
「Heh heh... It seems I've been rude.」

837:t_1:19.en:
$$長老$$
「You have gained power. Enough power to move a star.」

837:t_1:20.en:
$$長老$$
「Mover of stars... I want you to save humanity with that power.」

837:t_1:21.en:
$$長老$$
「Even if, as a result, Earth must be sacrificed.」

837:t_1:23.en:
$$長老$$
「Humanity is about to surpass the Age of Fire, the power of 'Gun', and welcome a new era.」

837:t_1:24.en:
$$長老$$
「Perhaps what awaits beyond that is a power that surpasses $$トップレス$$...」

837:t_1:25.en:
$$長老$$
「Yes... If I had to compare it, the power of the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

837:t_1:26.en:
$$長老$$
「$$バアル$$, existing through a concept opposed to the power of life... In other words, the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

837:t_1:27.en:
$$長老$$
「That may be where humanity is headed.」

837:t_1:28.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...What happens from here on is for whoever survives to decide.」

837:t_1:29.en:
$$長老$$
「I suppose that is all mere mortals can do.」

837:t_1:30.en:
$$長老$$
「Thank you, mover of stars. I wanted to meet you in person and confirm it.」

837:t_1:31.en:
$$長老$$
「I will give you the key.」

837:t_1:32.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The key... The power to save humanity...」

837:t_1:33.en:
$$長老$$
「Yes. I entrust it to you.」

837:t_1:34.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Wait for me, $$ノノ$$... I'm coming to save you...)

837:t_1:35.en:
$$ラルク$$
(But that isn't because I'm your Big Sis. I'm your...)

837:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The final battle, set in the galactic center...」

837:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Rough going from the very first step, I'm afraid...」

837:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But having come this far, there's no turning back! All that's left is to fight with everything we've got!」

837:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, that being the case, we do what we always do! Let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

838:t_000:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「All going well, all going well. The fields wrapped around each ship are stable, too.」

838:t_000:1.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「To think we'd actually succeed in fighting side by side with that writhing metal.」

838:t_000:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「You knew about the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, $$ロージェノム$$?」

838:t_000:3.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「They belonged to a world different from ours, but I had heard stories about them.」

838:t_000:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Their biology is so different from organic life forms that the two reportedly kept a stance of near non-interference toward each other.」

838:t_000:5.en:
$$ニア$$
「Did the Spiral race also travel between parallel worlds?」

838:t_000:6.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「In a limited way.」

838:t_000:7.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「And it seems our ancestors once fought those beings called the $$御使い$$, together with the $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

838:t_000:8.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Maybe the reason the $$ゼントラーディ$$ feel nostalgia for Spiral technology is that the memory of that battle is carved into their genes.」

838:t_000:9.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But we must not forget.」

838:t_000:10.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That even when the prehistoric civilizations, said to have built more advanced civilizations than today's in each of their worlds, joined forces, they still could not defeat those Angels.」

838:t_000:11.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「We're taking on an enemy that powerful...」

838:t_000:12.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「If we sink into despair, defeat is certain... But clinging to irresponsible hope offers no chance of victory, either.」

838:t_000:13.en:
$$ニア$$
「$c holds the key to cutting a path through that.」

838:t_000:14.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「What is that key?」

838:t_000:15.en:
$$ニア$$
「It is what we have built up through all the battles until today.」

838:t_000:16.en:
$$ニア$$
「Because of that, the $$暗黒大陸$$ became the $$新世界大陸$$, and I was united with $$シモン$$.」

838:t_000:18.en:
$$ニア$$
「Believing in your friends and yourself, and joining your feelings and strength as one... That is all there is to it.」

838:t_000:19.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Hmm... Indeed, that may be the truth...」

838:t_000:20.en:
$$シベラ$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary confirmed! Something is transferring into this dimension!」

838:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「To think they'd attack in this space...!」

838:t_001:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「They don't intend to let us advance!」

838:t_002:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Attacks are concentrating on the two ships on the left and right wings!」

838:t_002:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「This is bad! Let's go back them up right away!」

838:t_002:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But if we break the fleet formation here, it will split our forces in two! That is probably the enemy's aim!」

838:t_002:3.en:
$$號$$
「We'll manage over here on our own! Main force, back up the $$マクロス・クォーター$$!」

838:t_002:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We have the $$フロンティア船団$$ with us! We can hold out on our own somehow!」

838:t_002:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Check the forces deployed on $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and the $$クォーター$$!」

838:t_002:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「On $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ there's $$マジンガーＺ$$, $$ビューナスＡ$$, $$ボスボロット$$, the $$ゲッター$$ Team, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ザンボット３$$...」

838:t_002:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「And $$トライダーＧ７$$ and the $$シャトル$$!」

838:t_002:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「On the $$クォーター$$, there's the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, Captain $$ガムリン$$, $$アクエリオン$$, $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$...」

838:t_002:9.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ and $$ラケージ$$ are also assigned there!」

838:t_002:10.en:
$$メラン$$
「What do we do, Captain $$ブライト$$...!?」

838:t_002:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have no choice but to send the main force to rescue one of them, and send the escort fleet to the other...!」

838:t_002:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Send main force to rescue $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$」
「Send main force to rescue $$マクロス・クォーター$$」

838:t_003:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All ships, go to the aid of $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

838:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Have the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ fall back and support the $$クォーター$$!」

838:t_004:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad! The hyperspace we're in now is going to collapse!」
